arxiv-1906-04954.title: Phase-Noise and Amplitude-Noise Measurement of DACs and DDSs
arxiv-1906-04954.creator: Claudio E. Calosso, A. Carolina Cárdenas Olaya, [0.5ex], Enrico Rubiola[1em] ∇ \nabla Istituto Nazionale di Ricerca Metrologica INRiM, Italy[1ex] ∃ \exists FEMTO-ST Institute, UBFC and CNRS, France[1em] http://rubiola.org
arxiv-1906-04954.description: Abstract This article proposes a method for the measurement of Phase Noise (PN, or PM noise) and Amplitude Noise (AN, or AM noise) of Digital-to-Analog Converters (DAC) and Direct Digital Synthesizers (DDS) based on modulation-index amplification. The carrier is first reduced by a controlled amount (30-40 dB) by adding a reference signal of nearly equal amplitude and opposite in phase.

arxiv-2102-13375.title: UOCS. IV. Discovery of diverse hot companions to blue stragglers in the old open cluster King 2
arxiv-2102-13375.creator: Vikrant V. Jadhav 1,2,*, Sindhu Pandey 3, Annapurni Subramaniam 1, Ram Sagar 1,3
arxiv-2102-13375.description: Abstract King 2, one of the oldest clusters in the Milky Way, with an age of ∼ \sim 6 Gyr and distance of ∼ 5700 \sim 5700 pc, has been observed with UVIT payload on the ASTROSAT . With membership information derived from Gaia EDR3, the cluster is found to have 39 blue straggler stars (BSSs).

arxiv-2304-05163.title: Self-Supervision for Medical Image Classification: State-of-the-Art Performance with ∼ \sim 100 Labeled Training Samples per Class
arxiv-2304-05163.creator: Maximilian Nielsen, Laura Wenderoth, Thilo Sentker, René Werner
arxiv-2304-05163.description: Abstract Is self-supervised deep learning (DL) for medical image analysis already a serious alternative to the de facto standard of end-to-end trained supervised DL? We tackle this question for medical image classification, with a particular focus on one of the currently most limiting factor of the field: the (non-)availability of labeled data.

arxiv-2307-05685.title: Entanglement transitions and quantum bifurcations under continuous long-range monitoring
arxiv-2307-05685.creator: Angelo Russomanno, Giulia Piccitto, Davide Rossini
arxiv-2307-05685.description: Abstract We study the asymptotic bipartite entanglement entropy of the quantum trajectories of a free-fermionic system, when subject to a continuous nonlocal monitoring. The measurements are described by Gaussian-preserving two-point operators, whose strength decays as a power-law with exponent α \alpha .

arxiv-2402-06053.title: Randomness Is All You Need: Semantic Traversal of Problem-Solution Spaces with Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-06053.creator: Thomas Sandholm, Sayandev Mukherjee, Bernardo A. Huberman
arxiv-2402-06053.description: Abstract We present a novel approach to exploring innovation problem and solution domains using LLM fine-tuning with a custom idea database. By semantically traversing the bi-directional problem and solution tree at different temperature levels we achieve high diversity in solution edit distance while still remaining close to the original problem statement semantically.

arxiv-2502-11250.title: Uncertainty-aware Step-wise Verification with Generative Reward Models
arxiv-2502-11250.creator: Zihuiwen Ye, Luckeciano Carvalho Melo, Younesse Kaddar, [0.3cm] Phil Blunsom, Sam Staton, Yarin Gal, [0.3cm] University of Oxford, Cohere
arxiv-2502-11250.description: Abstract Complex multi-step reasoning tasks, such as solving mathematical problems, remain challenging for large language models (LLMs). While outcome supervision is commonly used, process supervision via process reward models (PRMs) provides intermediate rewards to verify step-wise correctness in solution traces. However, as proxies for human judgement, PRMs suffer from reliability issues, including susceptibility to reward hacking.

pmc-10581004.title: Perianal Pseudoverrucous Papules and Nodules in an Elderly Patient
pmc-10581004.creator: En Hyung Kim, Jun Su Park, Ji Su Lee, Ji Yeoun Lee
pmc-10581004.description: Pseudoverrucous papules and nodules is a reaction to irritation usually associated with urostomies. We report a case of perianal pseudoverrucous papules and nodules in an elderly patient who developed a characteristic diaper dermatitis after infrequent diaper change. The perianal papulonodular lesions improved after saline wet dressing and topical steroid application.

pmc-10626280.title: Urinary SPP1 has potential as a non‐invasive diagnostic marker for focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
pmc-10626280.creator: Qinglin Ye, Guiling Xu, Chao Xue, Shuting Pang, Boji Xie, Guanwen Huang, Haoyu Li, Xuesong Chen, Rirong Yang, Wei Li
pmc-10626280.description: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) is a type of chronic glomerular nephropathy showing characteristic glomerular sclerosis, diagnosed by kidney biopsy. However, it is difficult and expensive to monitor disease progression with repeated renal biopsy in clinical practice, and thus here we explored the feasibility of urine biomarkers as non‐invasive diagnostic tools.

pmc-10994604.title: Clinical and radiological outcomes of open reduction alone versus open reduction with pelvic osteotomy for developmental dysplasia of the hip in children over 1.5 years of age
pmc-10994604.creator: Ali Saleh Aljanabi, Wissam Saleh Hakim
pmc-10994604.description: Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) is commonly addressed through surgical intervention, usually performed in a specialized tertiary care facility. The purpose of this study was to evaluate the surgical outcomes in patients with DDH who had open reduction alone or in conjunction with bone surgery at our facility.

pmc-12465919.title: Radiofrequency rhizotomy for multiple sclerosis–related trigeminal neuralgia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12465919.creator: Bardia Hajikarimloo, Salem M Tos, Ibrahim Mohammadzadeh, Dorsa Najari, Azin Ebrahimi, Arman Hasanzade, Fatemeh Ghorbanpouryami, Mohammad Amin Habibi
pmc-12465919.description: BackgroundRadiofrequency rhizotomy (RFR) is one of the primary therapeutic options for managing patients suffering from multiple sclerosis-related trigeminal neuralgia (MS-TN). Given the increasing use of RFR for MS-TN and the absence of consensus on its efficacy, we aimed to assess the clinical application of RFR in this patient population.MethodsOn April 7, 2025, we conducted a systematic literature search.

pmc-12508481.title: The CGG triplet repeat binding protein 1 counteracts R-loop induced transcription-replication stress
pmc-12508481.creator: Henning Ummethum, Augusto C Murriello, Marcel Werner, Elizabeth Márquez-Gómez, Ann-Christine König, Elisabeth Kruse, Maxime Lalonde, Manuel Trauner, Anna Chanou, Matthias Weiβ, Clare S K Lee, Andreas Ettinger, Florian Erhard, Stefanie M Hauck, Stephan Hamperl
pmc-12508481.description: The CGG triplet repeat binding protein 1 (CGGBP1) binds to CGG repeats and has several important cellular functions, but how this DNA sequence-specific binding factor affects transcription and replication processes is an open question. Here, we show that CGGBP1 binds human gene promoters containing short (< 5) CGG-repeat tracts prone to R-loop formation.

pmc-12520357.creator: Alberto Ballin, Véronique Albanèse, Samia Miled, Véronique Legros, Guillaume Chevreux, Agathe Verraes, Anne Friedrich, Sébastien Léon, Anita Hopper, Anita Hopper, Anita Hopper
pmc-12520357.description: The yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae thrives in sugar-rich environments by rapidly consuming glucose and favoring alcoholic fermentation. This strategy is tightly regulated by the glucose repression pathway, which prevents the expression of genes required for the utilization of alternative carbon source.

pmc-12559340.title: Wear behaviour of hybrid ceramic reinforced FSP surface composite at varying temperatures
pmc-12559340.creator: Venkatesh Chenrayan, Kiran Shahapurkar, Panneerselvam Natarajan, Vijayabhaskara Rao Bhaviripudi, Vineet Tirth, Ali Algahtani, Jana Petrů, Muhammad Nasir Bashir, Manzoore Elahi M Soudagar

pmc-12670704.title: Camouflaging Autism in Pursuit of Friendship and Intimate Relationships: A Systematic Review
pmc-12670704.creator: Kathryn Ridgway, Kassandrah Cooke, David H Demmer, Merrilyn Hooley, Elizabeth Westrupp, Mark A Stokes
pmc-12670704.description: Background:Difficulties in making and maintaining social relationships is common among autistic people. These difficulties are thought to be due to differences in autistic social interaction and social communication that have been theorized to be the result of reduced social motivation.

pmc-12957687.title: Women’s health is a team effort: probiogenomics supports the development of a multi-species vaginal probiotic
pmc-12957687.creator: Chiara Maria Calvanese, Vincenzo Valentino, Annachiara De Prisco, Serena Allesina, Angela Amoruso, Francesca Deidda, Annalisa Visciglia, Danilo Ercolini, Marco Pane, Francesca De Filippis
pmc-12957687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The healthy vaginal microbiota is typically dominated by Lactobacillus species, while the dominance of different taxa often signals dysbiosis. Vaginal probiotics offer a promising therapeutic avenue to restore microbial balance and prevent recurrent infections. Using probiogenomics, this study investigated 19 novel strains belonging to four Lactobacillus species (Lactobacillus crispatus, Lactobacillus gasseri, Lactobacillus paragasseri, Limosilactobacillus fermentum) isolated from the vaginal environment of fertile and menopausal women.

pmc-13264249.title: Endocytic turnover of endothelial cell-membrane proteins as a driver of rat blood-brain barrier specialization and dysfunction
pmc-13264249.creator: Alba Tomás-Sitjes, Gianluca Arauz-Garofalo, Marina Gay, Sònia Jarió, Marta Vilaseca, Valentina Schastlivaia, Maaike Kessen, Nicola Manicardi, Giuseppe Battaglia, Daniel Gonzalez-Carter
pmc-13264249.description: SummaryThe blood-brain barrier (BBB), formed primarily by specialized brain endothelial cells (BEC), is essential for nutrient transport, signal transduction, immune cell migration, and pathogen restriction. Although these functions are influenced by the identity and abundance of cell-membrane proteins, the role of protein endocytic turnover rate (ETOR, the dynamics of protein internalization, recycling, and degradation) governing BBB physiology remains poorly understood.

pmc-13476118.title: Robotic-assisted thoracic duct ligation surgery guided by intralymphatic injection of indocyanine green
pmc-13476118.creator: Oleg A Karpov, Thabbta Vianna, Sanjeet Singh Avtaar Singh, Tom Blankenstein, John McLenachan, Malcolm Will
pmc-13476118.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Post-operative chyle leak is an uncommon but significant complication that can delay recovery and increase morbidity. Thoracic duct ligation is a recognized treatment option but may be technically challenging due to poor intraoperative visualization and numerous anatomical variations. This case report describes the use of indocyanine green (ICG) administered via intralymphatic injections, facilitating intraoperative guidance for precise thoracic duct localization and ligation in a complex patient who developed a chyle leak following a bilateral neck dissection.

pmc-13589775.title: NPLOC4通过增强Wnt/β-catenin介导的线粒体自噬促进肝细胞癌细胞增殖、侵袭和迁移
pmc-13589775.creator: Shuai Liang, Zichuan Lu, Zhongcheng Zhu, Tiantian Tang, Ke Ye, 朴 田
pmc-13589775.description: 目的线粒体自噬失调可导致肝细胞癌(hepatocellular carcinoma，HCC)的发生与发展。核蛋白定位4同源物(nuclear protein localization 4 homolog，NPLOC4)是多种细胞过程中的必需蛋白质，与多种肿瘤有关。研究表明NPLOC4参与线粒体自噬的调节，但其在HCC中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在探究NPLOC4在HCC线粒体自噬中的作用及调控机制。方法对来源于基因表达综合数据库(Gene Expression Omnibus，GEO)的GSE277232和GSE251942数据集中的RNA测序数据和来源于GeneCards数据库的线粒体自噬相关基因进行分析，筛选出HCC中与线粒体自噬相关的差异表达基因，并对NPLOC4的表达进行分析，同时通过蛋白质印迹法进行验证。采用干扰小RNA(small interfering RNA，siRNA)敲低HCC细胞中NPLOC4的表达以进行功能缺失试验。采用线粒体自噬相关蛋白质表达分析、透射电子显微镜、免疫荧光染色方法来分析线粒体自噬水平。结果通过生物信息学筛选发现，NPLOC4是一种关键的线粒体自噬相关差异表达基因。NPLOC4在HCC中显著高表达，并与不良临床预后相关(均P<0.05)。敲低NPLOC4抑制了HCC细胞增殖、迁移、侵袭，并促进了细胞凋亡(均P<0.05)。此外，敲低NPLOC4还抑制了HCC细胞线粒体自噬和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路(均P<0.05)。使用Wnt激动剂BML-284后，NPLOC4敲低对线粒体自噬的抑制作用被抵消(P<0.05)，这表明NPLOC4敲低通过抑制Wnt/β-catenin信号通路调控线粒体自噬。使用线粒体自噬诱导剂羰基氰化物间氯苯腙(carbonyl cyanide m-chlorophenyl hydrazone，CCCP)后，也逆转了NPLOC4敲低对HCC细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭的抑制作用(均P<0.05)，这表明NPLOC4敲低通过调节线粒体自噬抑制HCC进程。结论NPLOC4在HCC中呈高表达。下调NPLOC4表达可抑制Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的激活，进而抑制线粒体自噬，最终抑制HCC细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭。NPLOC4可能作为HCC潜在的生物标志物及治疗靶点。Keywords: 肝细胞癌, NPLOC4, 线粒体自噬, 增殖, 迁移, 侵袭 原发性肝癌是第六大常见的癌症类型，也是癌症相关死亡的第三大原因[1]。肝细胞癌(hepatocellular carcinoma，HCC)是原发性肝癌的主要组织学类型，在肝癌诊断和死亡病例中占绝大多数。尽管进行了广泛的努力，晚期HCC的治疗选择仍然有限，5年生存率仍然很低[2]。因此，识别和了解导致肿瘤发生与发展的分子机制至关重要。 线粒体自噬是一种选择性的自噬形式，其通过去除受损的线粒体，从而维持线粒体和细胞的稳态[3]。近年来，线粒体自噬因其在肿瘤发生和进展中的双重作用而受到更多关注。在癌症的早期阶段，线粒体自噬通过消除受损的线粒体，减少活性氧(reactive oxygen species，ROS)的产生，从而维持细胞内稳态[4]。例如，PTEN诱导的假定激酶1(PTEN-induced putative kinase 1，PINK1)和Parkin是泛素依赖性线粒体自噬途径中的关键蛋白质[5]，已被证明在肿瘤抑制中至关重要[6]。相反，在晚期肿瘤阶段，线粒体自噬通过调节肿瘤微环境中的代谢需求、细胞存活和炎症状态来促进肿瘤侵袭和转移[4]。例如，铁氧还蛋白1(ferredoxin 1，FDX1)通过下调线粒体自噬和PI3K/Akt信号通路，诱导ROS产生，从而促进HCC进展[7]。然而，线粒体自噬在HCC中的失调机制尚不完全清楚。 核蛋白定位4同源物(nuclear protein localization 4 homolog，NPLOC4)是多种细胞过程中的必需蛋白质，特别是与内质网相关的细胞过程。它作为含缬酪肽蛋白[valosin-containing protein (p97)，p97/VCP]复合物的辅助因子，通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统对蛋白质的质量控制和降解至关重要[8]。NPLOC4已被证实与多种肿瘤有关[9]，还可通过β-catenin/糖原合成酶激酶-3β(glycogen synthase kinase 3β，GSK3β)通路调节线粒体自噬，加重心力衰竭[10]。此外，Wnt/β-catenin信号通路与细胞功能和疾病进展中的线粒体自噬有着密切关系。例如，沉默驱动蛋白家族成员23(kinesin family member 23，KIF23)通过Wnt/β-catenin通路调节线粒体自噬，抑制甲状腺乳头状癌转移[11]。然而，关于NPLOC4是否通过Wnt/β-catenin通路调节线粒体自噬参与HCC进展的研究较少。 本研究旨在探究NPLOC4在HCC进程中的关键作用，明确其与线粒体自噬的关联及潜在机制，以期为HCC的诊断和靶向治疗提供新的策略。 材料与方法 数据来源 使用基因表达综合数据库(Gene Expression Omnibus，GEO)中的GSE277232和GSE251942数据集来确定差异表达的mRNA，并分析NPLOC4 mRNA的表达。通过R软件包survminer绘制NPLOC4相关的Kaplan-Meier生存分析曲线。 细胞培养 本研究使用人正常肝细胞THLE-2(购自长沙艾碧维生物科技有限公司)和HCC细胞HepG2(购自武汉普诺赛生命科技有限公司)、Huh7(购自武汉普诺赛生命科技有限公司)、Huh6(购自武汉普诺赛生命科技有限公司)、MHCC-97H(购自长沙艾碧维生物科技有限公司)。细胞在37 ℃、5% CO2的细胞培养箱中培养。HepG2、Huh7、Huh6细胞使用含1%抗生素和10%胎牛血清(均购自美国Sigma-Aldrich公司)的DMEM培养基。MHCC-97H细胞使用含1%抗生素和10%胎牛血清的MEM培养基。定期观察细胞生长状态，细胞进入对数生长期后可进行后续实验操作。 细胞处理 采用干扰小RNA(small interfering RNA，siRNA)敲低HCC细胞中NPLOC4的表达以进行功能缺失试验。使用Lipofectamine 2000转染试剂(购自美国Thermofisher公司)，严格按照说明书操作流程，将靶向敲低NPLOC4的质粒(si-NPLOC4)及其空白对照质粒(si-NC)转染至Huh7和MHCC-97H细胞。si-NPLOC4的具体序列如下：si-NPLOC4#1，5'-GACA-ATATCATGTTTGAGAAT-3'；si-NPLOC4#2，5'-GA-GCTTCTTGAGGATCCAAAA-3'；si-NPLOC4#3，5'- GACACCTATTTCCTAAGTTCA-3'。 为探究Wnt/β-catenin信号通路是否介导NPLOC4对线粒体自噬的调控作用，在Huh7和MHCC-97H细胞中转染si-NPLOC4后加入0.
